bug_semantics: Stored XSS in the authenticated WebUI RSE-management flow. A privileged attacker can create an RSE with HTML/JavaScript in city, country_name, or ISP; add_rse.js serializes those values unchanged into POST /rses/<RSE>, and the backend persists them. Later, the /rses listing supplies the server values directly to DataTables, while /rse?rse=<RSE> builds table-row HTML by concatenating the returned values into jQuery append calls. Either sink parses the stored metadata as markup, so merely viewing the listing or detail page executes attacker JavaScript in the victim's WebUI origin. The advisory notes JavaScript-readable session/API tokens and same-origin privileged requests as impact amplifiers.
flaw_origin: Direct, single-parent feature commit 8f1a24a568331b10f9d8fb099ef233af340b7735 added the RSE create/list/detail WebUI in new files. It simultaneously introduced the persistence path in add_rse.js, the raw DataTables listing sink in rses.js, and the raw string-concatenation table sink in rse.js; this is original vulnerable code, not a move, refactor, revert, backport, or merge carrier.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file commit 8f1a24a568331b10f9d8fb099ef233af340b7735` shows author and committer `Hannes Hansen <hannes.jakob.hansen@cern.ch>` and only the message `WebUI: added support for getting informations, creation and deletion of RSEs and attributes Fix #80`; there is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI-tool trailer, or bot identity.
evidence: First-party GHSA-h9fp-p2p9-873q in the assigned bundle names stored XSS in city/country_name/ISP, POST /proxy/rses/XSSTEST, trigger pages Admin > RSE Management and its RSE detail, and patched versions 35.8.3, 38.5.4, and 39.3.1. In the validated clone, `git diff c77904c15e1958ad9f32e862b9e9714e48076434 8f1a24a568331b10f9d8fb099ef233af340b7735 -- lib/rucio/web/ui/static/rse.js lib/rucio/web/ui/static/rses.js` shows both files created: rses.js passes `data` to DataTable with city/country_name/ISP columns, and rse.js concatenates `data[sorted_keys[i]]` into a `<td>`. `git show 8f1a24a568331b10f9d8fb099ef233af340b7735:lib/rucio/web/ui/static/add_rse.js` shows those fields read from DOM inputs and sent unchanged through r.add_rse; the same commit's rucio.js diff implements JSON POST `/rses/` + rse. `git log --format='%H %s' -L 13,35:lib/rucio/web/ui/static/rses.js a3618f46cde422d762e0bca8ffa219cfe7703003` returns only the branch fix and 8f1a24a568331b10f9d8fb099ef233af340b7735 for the vulnerable block; `git log a3618f46cde422d762e0bca8ffa219cfe7703003 -S'data: data' -- lib/rucio/web/ui/static/rses.js` likewise returns a3618f46cde422d762e0bca8ffa219cfe7703003 and 8f1a24a568331b10f9d8fb099ef233af340b7735. For the detail sink, `git log 24468abb0e076fa83d5f3bc6db6050182fed4c79 -S'+ data[sorted_keys[i]] +' -- lib/rucio/web/ui/static/rse.js` returns fix 24468abb0e076fa83d5f3bc6db6050182fed4c79 and the same BIC. `git ls-tree -r --name-only c77904c15e1958ad9f32e862b9e9714e48076434 -- lib/rucio/web/ui/static/rse.js lib/rucio/web/ui/static/rses.js` is empty, directly proving parent absence. `git describe --tags --contains 8f1a24a568331b10f9d8fb099ef233af340b7735` yields `1.18.0^2~3^2~2`, and sorted containing tags start at 1.18.0. On the canonical master lineage, fce81437e2e647a0da6e348167ea1df26db87c0c replaces detail-page string concatenation with element construction and `.text()`, then closing commit b96c1feee372b285c1db881db5bc297a40645b25 replaces raw listing data with encoded values before DataTables; `git log --ancestry-path --format='%H %P %s' fce81437e2e647a0da6e348167ea1df26db87c0c^..b96c1feee372b285c1db881db5bc297a40645b25` proves that order, and `git describe --tags --contains b96c1feee372b285c1db881db5bc297a40645b25` yields `40.0.0rc1~75`, so release 40 was fixed from its first RC. Release-branch closing equivalents are a3618f46cde422d762e0bca8ffa219cfe7703003 (35.8.3), abf5e978ee3910590a23c6705e6a0105c0b847c7 (38.5.4), and 80b91dd0c6737b2ab9aed039470e8e81028def41 (39.3.1): `git tag --contains` restricted to 35.8.*, 38.5.*, and 39.3.* begins at exactly those patched tags, while `git diff 35.8.2 35.8.3`, `git diff --stat 38.5.3 38.5.4`, and `git diff --stat 39.3.0 39.3.1` over rse.js and rses.js show both vulnerable sinks changing at each boundary.
reasoning: The advisory's two trigger pages map to two output sinks, but both were first written together by 8f1a24a568331b10f9d8fb099ef233af340b7735. Blame, -L, and two independent -S searches converge on that feature commit, whose direct parent lacks both files; later edits such as bf34d52068 merely reorganized parts of rse.js and did not originate the raw metadata rendering. The complete canonical repair is the ordered pair fce81437e2e647a0da6e348167ea1df26db87c0c (detail) followed by b96c1feee372b285c1db881db5bc297a40645b25 (listing); b96c1feee372b285c1db881db5bc297a40645b25 is therefore the direct closing fix represented in fix_sha, with equivalent branch commits in all three advisory patch releases. AI attribution is judged only on the BIC object: it identifies a human author/committer and contains no qualifying AI marker. Therefore the root-cause vulnerable code is NOT_AI.
